source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting a failed industrial safety audit

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Record date, time, and location of the audit.
3. List audit team participants (names, titles, and roles).
4. Detail the purpose of the audit (compliance check, risk assessment, standard adherence).
5. Categorize non-conformities and violations identified – safety devices not functioning, PPE not available/worn, improper equipment usage, untrained staff, incomplete or outdated training records, unsafe work practices, poor hazard recognition, lack of emergency preparedness, environmental regulations breaches, etc.
6. Include photographs, diagrams, or any visual documentation showing the violations.
7. Summarize findings – common themes, patterns, or especially egregious issues.
8. Describe any immediate corrective actions taken or required.
9. List recommendations for long-term corrective actions.
10. Include any feedback or responses from those being audited.
11. Indicate deadlines for corrective actions to be completed.
12. Record any follow-up inspections scheduled for verification.
